parked.spanish: Todos días que la plaga en él se impurecerá; impuro él; solo se sentará; a fuera al campamento su morada.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms יִטְמָא is a separate predicate of the 3ms person (טָמֵא הוּא), after בּוֹ. Spanish makes הַנֶּגַע the subject of se impurecerá, so the plague becomes impure, and se adds a reflexive stem the qal does not mark.
findings.spanishSpan: la plaga en él se impurecerá

findings.issue: Qal imperfect ישב stays open between sit and dwell/remain; se sentará selects sitting and uses reflexive se as Spanish intransitive smoothing.
Noun בָּדָד is isolation/apart; solo can also be read as only.
מִחוּץ is min plus outside before לְ the camp; a fuera can be read as motion toward, beside al.
